title: mentha × rotundifolia f. bullata
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia f. bullata, commonly known as Bullata Pennyroyal, is a subspecies of the mint plant that is known for its distinctive, rounded leaves. It has been used for various health benefits, including its antispasmodic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Bullata Pennyroyal include essential oils, such as menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, anti-arthritic, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and combat microbial infections, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
